queries.households_without_viewing: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM households h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.household_id = h.household_id)
queries.missing_outcomes: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM households WHERE outcome_observed != 1 OR returned_d29_56 IS NULL
queries.duplicate_households: SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT household_id) FROM households
queries.orphan_events: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e LEFT JOIN households h USING(household_id) WHERE h.household_id IS NULL
queries.invalid_availability: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e JOIN titles t USING(title_id) WHERE e.day < t.available_day
queries.invalid_watch_time: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE minutes < 0 OR minutes > runtime_minutes
queries.invalid_return_window: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM households WHERE (returned_d29_56 = 1 AND (return_day < 29 OR return_day > 56)) OR (returned_d29_56 = 0 AND return_day != -1)
queries.itt_left_join_count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT h.household_id FROM households h LEFT JOIN events e USING(household_id) GROUP BY h.household_id)

memo.reason: The fixed-horizon target interval does not establish a practically worthwhile benefit. Non-significance is not equivalence.

No claim about a title's creative quality or artistic value.
Nine held-out experiments cannot establish transportability across policies.
Follow up with new preregistered experiments, equivalence margins, and external validation; do not extend this run until significant.

calibration_flags: At true effect 4 pp, the Monte Carlo coverage interval excludes nominal 95% coverage. Investigate in a new, prospectively specified simulation study; do not tune this run to pass.
operating.scope: Target inference only, using the same household return DGP. Null rejection is false-positive rate; non-null rejection is two-sided power. Wilson intervals quantify Monte Carlo uncertainty. Candidate-surrogacy certification is not implied.
